title: Propagate authenticated service identity and tenant from reconciliation-drift to telemetry ingest
summary: Fixes official release 37563827831 stimulus failure where scheduled reconciliation append to Telemetry returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized (reconciliation_append_not_accepted, receipt status terminal_rejected, outcome failed, attempt 1, retryable false). Implemented append_lifecycle_event in services/reconciliation-drift/telemetry_client.py using PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN and X-Tenant-Id, delegated _append_telemetry_lifecycle_event in services/reconciliation-drift/main.py with explicit tenant propagation, added PANTHEON_TENANT_ID fallback to reconciliation-drift-svc in docker-compose.yml, updated compose contract test scripts/test_worker_tenant_compose_contract.py, and added comprehensive reproduction and verification tests in services/reconciliation-drift/tests/test_telemetry_client_auth.py.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Reproduce actual reconciliation append HTTP401 across real owner auth transport contract and identify precise cause before repair
acceptance_verification.detail: Root cause identified: PR #6196 authenticated fetch_runtime_summaries on reads but left append_lifecycle_event unauthenticated with hardcoded Content-Type/Accept headers and no Authorization or X-Tenant-Id headers on POST /api/telemetry/ingest. Missing credentials directly reproduced with HTTP 401 terminal rejection (error: telemetry ingest returned HTTP 401, code: 401 / AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING) in services/reconciliation-drift/tests/test_telemetry_client_auth.py::test_append_lifecycle_event_missing_credential_reproduction and test_scheduled_reconcile_missing_token_reproduces_stimulus_failure.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Reuse existing legitimate configured service identity with least scope and preserve tenant environment binding and paper-live fences
acceptance_verification.detail: Reused existing PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN service credential accepted by Telemetry with role 'service' and X-Tenant-Id header matching the event/tenant context. Added PANTHEON_TENANT_ID: ${PANTHEON_TENANT_ID:-${PANTHEON_BFF_TENANT_ID:-default}} to reconciliation-drift-svc in docker-compose.yml, preserving tenant boundaries and environment fences.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Exercise scheduled reconciliation through real Telemetry HTTP auth boundary with durable accepted append and invalid or missing credential denial
acceptance_verification.detail: Exercised scheduled reconciliation endpoint against real Telemetry HTTP auth boundary. Verified HTTP 202 accepted receipt with event_id matching on authenticated token; verified HTTP 401 terminal rejection on missing/empty token; verified HTTP 401 on invalid token; verified HTTP 403 on tenant mismatch and forbidden tenant.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Do not turn configured owner failures into successful empty data or ACK before durable append
acceptance_verification.detail: Preserved receipt semantics: 202 accepted marks terminal success; 401/403 errors mark terminal rejection without ACK; 5xx/network errors retain retryable status; no swallow-to-empty or false ACK.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Do not expose secrets forge credentials weaken auth create new owner or replay hosted terminal rejects
acceptance_verification.detail: Zero hardcoded secrets or forged tokens; reused existing env service tokens and legitimate Telemetry authority endpoints; no new owner created; no replay of rejected events.

acceptance_verification.criterion: Exact-head independent review and canonical integration with source-only versus hosted claims explicitly separated
acceptance_verification.detail: All tests run locally in test virtual environment (.venv-pantheon); hosted dev VM deployment separated from local source verification.
